```{r} #| label: setup-explorer #| message: false #| warning: false #| echo: false library(tidyverse) library(jsonlite) library(leaflet) library(plotly) library(crosstalk) library(DT) # Stadium geographic coordinates coords <- tibble::tribble( ~venue_name, ~lat, ~lng, "American Family Field", 43.0280, -87.9712, "Angel Stadium", 33.8003, -117.8827, "Busch Stadium", 38.6226, -90.1928, "Chase Field", 33.4453, -112.0667, "Citi Field", 40.7571, -73.8458, "Citizens Bank Park", 39.9061, -75.1665, "Comerica Park", 42.3411, -83.0485, "Coors Field", 39.7559, -104.9942, "Daikin Park", 29.7573, -95.3555, "Fenway Park", 42.3467, -71.0972, "Globe Life Field", 32.7473, -97.0845, "Great American Ball Park", 39.0979, -84.5082, "Kauffman Stadium", 39.0517, -94.4803, "Nationals Park", 38.8730, -77.0074, "Oracle Park", 37.7786, -122.3893, "Oriole Park at Camden Yards", 39.2838, -76.6217, "PNC Park", 40.4469, -80.0057, "Petco Park", 32.7076, -117.1570, "Progressive Field", 41.4962, -81.6852, "Rate Field", 41.8300, -87.6339, "Rogers Centre", 43.6414, -79.3894, "Sutter Health Park", 38.5804, -121.5138, "T-Mobile Park", 47.5914, -122.3323, "Target Field", 44.9817, -93.2778, "Tropicana Field", 27.7682, -82.6534, "Truist Park", 33.8908, -84.4678, "UNIQLO Field at Dodger Stadium", 34.0739, -118.2400, "Wrigley Field", 41.9484, -87.6553, "Yankee Stadium", 40.8296, -73.9262, "loanDepot park", 25.7783, -80.2196 ) parks <- fromJSON("data/park_dimensions_factors.json") |> as_tibble() parks_2026 <- parks |> filter(season == 2026, split == "All") |> inner_join(coords, by = "venue_name") |> mutate( marker_color = case_when( index_hr >= 105 ~ "#ef4444", index_hr <= 95 ~ "#38bdf8", TRUE ~ "#94a3b8" ), category = case_when( index_hr >= 105 ~ "Hitter Friendly (>105)", index_hr <= 95 ~ "Pitcher Friendly (<95)", TRUE ~ "Neutral (95-105)" ) ) # Statcast Home Run data hr_data <- fromJSON("data/statcast_homeruns.json") |> as_tibble() |> mutate( batter_hand = if_else(stand == "L", "Left-Handed", "Right-Handed") ) shared_hr <- SharedData$new(hr_data) ``` ::: {.glass-card} Click any ballpark pin below to view its physical specifications, altitude, roof design, and 2026 Statcast Home Run Factor. Marker colors signify **Hitter-Friendly (Red)**, **Pitcher-Friendly (Blue)**, and **Neutral (Gray)**. ```{r} #| label: map-leaflet #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false leaflet(parks_2026, height = 500, options = leafletOptions(minZoom = 3, maxZoom = 14)) |> addTiles() |> setView(lng = -96.5, lat = 39.5, zoom = 4) |> addCircleMarkers( lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat, radius = ~pmax(8, (index_hr - 65) / 4), fillColor = ~marker_color, fillOpacity = 0.85, color = "#ffffff", weight = 2, label = ~paste0(venue_name, " (", team, " • HR Index: ", index_hr, ")"), popup = ~paste0( "
